schoolServices.title: SDSU Safe Ride
schoolServices.description: Free rides for students, faculty and staff from more than 30 campus locations. Request one in the SDSU Safe app.

schoolServices.title: Math & Science Learning Center
schoolServices.description: Free drop-in tutoring and course office hours for math and science. Come during the posted hours.

schoolServices.title: Free professional headshots
schoolServices.description: Free headshots for current SDSU students at The Backdoor Studio. Walk-ins are welcome, and an appointment is recommended.

apartments.title: South Campus Plaza
apartments.summary: Studios and shared units on the south edge of campus, with a market and the trolley at the door.

apartments.title: BLVD63
apartments.summary: A College Area building a short walk up the hill, with studios and a few larger floor plans.

apartments.title: The Granada
apartments.summary: Apartments across Montezuma from campus. A crosswalk and you are on the edge of school.

apartments.title: University Towers
apartments.summary: A tall student building with furnished rooms and shares, close enough to walk between classes.

apartments.title: Unscripted
apartments.summary: Furnished studios near campus for a student who wants their own door and a short commute.

apartments.title: Fifty Six East
apartments.summary: Apartments just east of campus. Walk it on a nice day, or catch the bus along the hill.
